About:

Meet Conan | Apply Here

Conan is a 6-month-old Jindo Mix weighing 13 lbs. Rescued as a tiny puppy found alone on a bed of rice straw, Conan made a choice early on — to trust people anyway. Energetic, sharp, and quick to learn, he's the kind of dog who walks up to a stranger tail-wagging and leaves them smiling without even realizing it. He can't wait to find his forever home in NYC!

You don’t have to wait for an adoption event. In-person meet-and-greets are available in the NYC area, with virtual meet-and-greets available for adopters outside NYC.
